title: Anthropic hackathon winner open-sourced his Claude setup
description:
Comment "SETUP" to get the repo 👆

Anthropic hackathon winner just open-sourced his full Claude Code setup. 181 skills, 47 subagents, 79 commands, refined over 10 months on real product work. Works in Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode and Gemini. Same setup he used to build a startup in 8 hours and win the grand prize.

#claudecode #anthropic #aitools #aicoding #devtools
